safe_steps: Unplug the machine and turn off the water supply
Check the drain hose for kinks or blockages
Clean the drain pump filter (usually behind a small front panel), with a towel ready for spilled water
call_technician_if: The filter is clear but the machine still won't drain, or the pump hums and never runs

safe_steps: Pause the cycle and redistribute heavy items evenly
Check that all four feet touch the floor and adjust them
Avoid washing a single heavy item alone
call_technician_if: Shaking continues with a balanced load and level feet, or you hear grinding

issue: Dirty condenser coils or blocked airflow
safe_steps: Vacuum dust from the coils (back or bottom grille)
Keep gaps around the fridge and don't overpack the vents inside
call_technician_if: Cleaning does not help within a day, or the compressor clicks on and off repeatedly

safe_steps: Wipe the door gasket with warm soapy water
Test the seal with a sheet of paper; it should resist being pulled out
Check the door isn't blocked by items inside
call_technician_if: The gasket is torn or the door still won't seal after cleaning

safe_steps: Turn the unit off and remove the front-panel filter
Rinse or vacuum the filter and let it dry fully
Reinstall it and run the unit in fan mode first
call_technician_if: Airflow stays weak or ice keeps forming after the filter is clean

safe_steps: Confirm the thermostat is in cool mode and set below room temperature
Make sure the filter is clean first
Do not attempt to handle refrigerant yourself
call_technician_if: Always. Refrigerant work requires a licensed technician
